battle.name: 瓦爾達納克特戰役
battle.theater: 阿拉斯河谷凡達納克特
battle.brief: 公元702至703年之際，亞美尼亞巴格拉圖尼氏的斯姆巴特六世以兩千人奇襲駐納赫切萬的伍麥葉王朝守軍五千人，阿拉伯軍隊向阿拉斯河潰退，溺斃與凍斃者甚眾。卡面的亞述長矛屬九百年前的高原冷兵器，此役並無其戰場記錄，勝負實由奇襲、騎兵與嚴寒決定。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏈頭。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 這場戰役在公元702至703年之際爆發於亞美尼亞東部的阿拉斯河谷，交戰一方是控制亞美尼亞的伍麥葉王朝（倭馬亞王朝）軍鎮，另一方是拒絕受其節制、並由拜占庭皇帝冊立的亞美尼亞巴格拉圖尼氏。阿拉伯方面的指揮官是亞美尼亞總督奧斯蒂坎，兵力是駐紮納赫切萬這座河畔要塞的守備部隊，加上沿河谷徵召的騎兵與步卒，合計約五千人，隸屬哈里發直轄的邊疆軍鎮，作戰與補給都以納赫切萬為基地。亞美方面的主力是斯姆巴特六世率領的兩千名巴格拉圖尼私兵與依附他的亞美貴族（nakh'arar）部眾，這支部隊曾被阿拉伯人徵用，熟識對方的戰法與行軍節奏。戰役背後還有第三方的影子：拜占庭帝國冊立斯姆巴特六世為亞美尼亞的君主，就是要在阿拉斯河上游建立一個反對伍麥葉的支點；哈里發則要守住這條連接美索不達米亞與高加索的通道。兩邊都把這條河谷視為必須拿下的邊界，因此沒有任何一方會容忍一個獨立的亞美尼亞存在。
countriesEn: The battle was fought in the Aras river valley of eastern Armenia in 702–703 AD, between the military administration of the Umayyad Caliphate, which controlled Armenia, and the Bagratuni family of Armenia, which refused to accept caliphal overlordship and had instead been installed by the Byzantine emperor. On the Arab side the commander was Ostikan, governor of Arminiya, and the force was the garrison of the river fortress of Nakhchivan together with horsemen and foot levied along the valley, about five thousand men in all, answerable directly to the caliph's frontier command and based for supply on Nakhchivan. On the Armenian side the main body was the two thousand Bagratuni retainers led by Smbat VI together with the Armenian noble (nakh'arar) clans who followed him; these troops had themselves been recruited by the Arabs and knew the enemy's habits and pace of march. A third party stood in the background: the Byzantine emperor had installed Smbat VI as ruler of Armenia precisely to establish a foothold against the Umayyads on the upper Araxes, while the caliph needed to hold the corridor that linked Mesopotamia with the Caucasus. Both sides treated this valley as a frontier that had to be taken, and neither could tolerate an independent Armenia.
people: 斯姆巴特六世是此役的核心人物。他是巴格拉圖尼氏的亞美尼亞君主，先前曾為哈里發效命、熟悉伍麥葉朝的兵制與宮廷，得到拜占庭冊立後轉而與阿拉伯人正面對抗。他手上真正能調動的只有約兩千人，遠少於對方五千人的守備軍，卻選擇主動出擊。阿拉伯方面的指揮官奧斯蒂坎是亞美尼亞（Arminiya）的總督，這個頭銜表明他既是伍麥葉政權派任的地方長官，也是本地的亞美人，在亞美尼亞各部族的效忠問題上扮演關鍵角色。戰役之後，急於挽回局面的哈里發派遣穆罕默德·伊本·馬爾萬與馬斯拉馬·伊本·阿卜杜勒·馬利克兩位將軍重新攻入亞美尼亞，建立伍麥葉的宗主權，並在704年把一批亞美貴族首腦聚集到納赫切萬的主教座堂內屠殺，再將教堂焚毀。亞美尼亞教會傳統把這批人記念為瓦斯普拉干的殉道者。冊立斯姆巴特的拜占庭皇帝此役並無直接動作，只提供了名分，遠在君士坦丁堡坐鎮。
peopleEn: Smbat VI is the central figure of the campaign. He was the Bagratuni prince of Armenia, formerly in the service of the caliph and familiar with Umayyad military practice and court life, and after receiving his investiture from Byzantium he turned openly against the Arabs. He could bring no more than about two thousand men to the field against a garrison of five thousand, yet he chose to strike first. The Arab commander, Ostikan, was governor of Arminiya; the title shows that he was at once an official appointed by the Umayyad state and an Armenian himself, and the loyalty of the Armenian tribes was the decisive question in his command. After the defeat, the caliph, eager to recover the position, sent two generals, Muhammad ibn Marwan and Maslamah ibn Abd al-Malik, back into Armenia to re-establish Umayyad suzerainty, and in 704 they assembled the Armenian noble leaders inside the cathedral at Nakhchivan, killed them there, and burned the church. Armenian church tradition commemorates the dead as the Martyrs of Vaspurakan. The Byzantine emperor who invested Smbat took no direct part in the fighting and supplied only the title, remaining far away at Constantinople.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛是公元前九百年前後的形制：短柄、長刃，鐵鏈頭直接套在木杆上，與弓、鐵器並用，是亞述人在兩河流域攻城拔寨的標準長兵。它代表的是亞拉臘特高原的矛兵傳統——亞述與烏拉爾圖的工匠早在青銅與鐵器之交就定型了這種套筒鐵矛頭，後來幾乎所有安納托利亞與高加索的長矛都從這個模樣長出來。但到了公元703年，這種短柄長刃矛早已退出一線軍備，只可能作為儀仗或古物存在；此役雙方真正上手的是更長的騎矛（kontos一類，長過兩米，騎兵夾槍衝撞）、投槍、複合反曲弓、直刃雙劍（亞美與拜占庭的雙手劍）、阿拉伯人的彎刀、圓盾，以及由小片甲片綴成的札甲與頭盔。戰場上還有兩種交通與後勤要素：戰馬、載運行李與軍需的駱駝和驢，以及納赫切萬的城塞與凡達納克特的圍牆。史料沒有記載任何攻城器械的使用。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card is a form of about 900 BC: a short shaft carrying a long blade, with an iron socket head fixed straight onto the wood, carried together with bow and ironwork as the standard lance of the Assyrians in Mesopotamia. It stands for the spear tradition of the Ararat highlands, where Assyrian and Urartian craftsmen had already fixed the socketed iron head at the transition from bronze to iron, and from which almost every later lance in Anatolia and the Caucasus grew. By 703 AD, however, this short-shafted blade had long left the front line and could survive only as a ceremonial or antiquarian form; what the two sides actually carried were longer cavalry lances of the kontos type, more than two metres, carried couched in the charge, together with javelins, composite recurve bows, straight double-edged swords of the Armenian and Byzantine type, the curved sabre of the Arabs, round shields, and armour built up from small plates and helmets. Two further elements of transport and supply matter: the warhorses, the baggage camels and donkeys, and the fortifications of the citadel at Nakhchivan and the walls of Vardanakert. The sources record no use of any siege engine.
tactics: 這場戰役的戰術核心是「以奇襲取全勝」和「以河流作陷阱」兩件事。斯姆巴特六世以兩千人對五千人，正面硬撼毫無勝算，因此選擇在阿拉伯軍隊尚未展開、士氣鬆散之際突然襲擊，令對手的數量優勢來不及發揮；冬季的天候也替亞美一方加了分，地面與河面結冰，人馬行動遲緩。衝擊一旦成功，潰退的阿拉伯軍隊被導向阿拉斯河：想渡河的人被急流沖走，留在冰面上的人則在嚴寒中凍斃，死者大半不是死在刀下，而是死在逃跑的路上。追擊與掃蕩隨之展開，斯姆巴特藉此收復亞美尼亞大部分地區，把阿拉伯守軍逐出各處城堡與要塞，重新控制河谷通道。整個作戰都依賴狹窄的河谷地形，因為它把對方的騎兵優勢與人數優勢同時壓縮；納赫切萬則是阿拉伯方面的集結與補給點，一旦被繞過，撤退的軍隊便失去重整的依靠。那件亞述短柄長刃長矛在此類遭遇戰中本可作為近身突刺的兵器使用，但真實交戰中，亞美方面的衝鋒靠的是長矛騎兵與步兵的劍盾配合，弓手則在兩翼提供掩護。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the battle lay in two things: winning everything with a surprise attack, and turning the river into a trap. Facing five thousand with two thousand, Smbat VI had no chance in a set-piece engagement, so he struck while the Arab force was still strung out and its morale broken; the winter weather also worked for the Armenians, since frozen ground and ice slowed men and horses. Once the shock landed, the routed Arabs were driven toward the Araxes: those who tried to swim were taken by the current, those who stayed on the ice were killed by the cold, and most of the dead fell not by the sword but on the road of flight. Pursuit and sweep followed, and Smbat used the victory to retake most of Armenia, drive the Arab garrisons out of their fortresses, and regain control of the valley roads. The whole operation depended on the narrow valley terrain, which compressed the enemy's advantage in numbers and cavalry alike; Nakhchivan was the Arab rallying and supply point, and once it was bypassed the fleeing army had nothing left to regroup around. The Assyrian short-shafted blade would have served as a close-quarter thrusting weapon in such an encounter, but in the actual fighting the Armenian charge rested on lance cavalry and sword-and-shield infantry, with archers covering the flanks.
data: 時間上，此役一般記為公元702至703年之際，具體月份多指703年1月，即敘利亞曆與亞美尼亞曆的冬末。作戰雙方的兵力，按現存最常被引用的說法，阿拉伯方為五千人，亞美方為兩千人；其中五千人是納赫切萬守備軍的總數，兩千人則是斯姆巴特六世能直接帶上來的私兵與貴族部眾。傷亡數字沒有可靠記載，只能確定的是：阿拉伯軍隊全軍崩潰，倖存者沿河逃亡時或溺斃或凍斃，因此這支部隊作為作戰力量在當場等於全滅；亞美方面的損失則輕微，戰記沒有列出任何陣亡名單。地理上，凡達納克特的位置在今亞塞拜然與土耳其交界一帶、阿拉斯河下游北岸，座標約為北緯40.29度、東經44.98度，與上游的納赫切萬相隔約一百二十餘公里，雙方沿河谷行軍一天可達；河谷冬季夜間氣溫在零度上下，阿拉臘特山高逾五千公尺，就在戰場南方數十公里處，構成地形上的標誌。一年之後的704年，納赫切萬主教座堂的屠殺事件發生；再之後，斯姆巴特六世據傳於約705年死在囚禁之中。
dataEn: On timing, the battle is generally placed at 702–703 AD, and the month most often given is January 703, the dead of winter in the Syrian and Armenian calendars. For the opposing forces, the figures most commonly cited give five thousand on the Arab side, the total strength of the Nakhchivan garrison, and two thousand on the Armenian side, the number of retainers and noble followers Smbat VI could bring directly into the field. There is no reliable casualty figure; what is certain is that the Arab force broke completely and the survivors were drowned or frozen to death as they fled along the river, so as a fighting force the detachment was wiped out on the spot, while the Armenian losses were light and no roll of the fallen survives. Geographically, Vardanakert lay in the Aras valley of what is now the Azerbaijan–Turkey borderland, on the north bank of the lower river, at about 40.29 degrees north and 44.98 degrees east, some hundred and twenty kilometres or so from Nakhchivan upstream, a day's march for either side along the valley; winter nights in the valley fell to around freezing, and Mount Ararat, over five thousand metres high, stood a few tens of kilometres to the south as the landmark of the ground. One year later, in 704, came the killing of the noble leaders in the cathedral at Nakhchivan; after that Smbat VI is reported to have died in captivity around 705.
cause: 戰爭的直接起因，是亞美尼亞在亞述帝國崩解之後成為哈里發國與拜占庭帝國爭奪的邊地。公元685年阿拉伯人進入亞美尼亞，此地被改編為伍麥葉王朝的亞美尼亞（Arminiya）省，亞美貴族要嘛皈依並接受徵用，要嘛淪為附庸；巴格拉圖尼氏的斯姆巴特六世本來也是這套體制內的受任者。當拜占庭皇帝冊立他為亞美尼亞君主，等於給了他一個正統的名分，他隨即拒絕再向哈里發效忠，起兵收回被阿拉伯人占據的城堡與土地。哈里發一方不能容忍邊境出現一個由拜占庭背書的亞美尼亞政權，於是亞美尼亞總督奧斯蒂坎率領納赫切萬守軍沿阿拉斯河谷進逼，而斯姆巴特以遠少於對方的兵力主動迎擊，先發制人。更深層的原因是帝國邊界的爭奪：這條河谷連著美索不達米亞、高加索與安納托利亞三方的交通線，誰控制它，誰就控制了在亞美尼亞與喬治亞之間的南北通道。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the war was Armenia's position after the collapse of Assyria, as a frontier disputed between the caliph and the Byzantine Empire. After the Arabs entered Armenia in 685, the country was reorganised as the province of Arminiya under the Umayyads, and the Armenian nobles either converted and were taken into service or remained subjects; Smbat VI of the Bagratuni was himself an office-holder within that system. When the Byzantine emperor invested him as ruler of Armenia, he was given a legitimate title, and he at once refused any further service to the caliph and rose to recover the castles and lands held by the Arabs. The caliph could not tolerate an Armenian polity on his border backed by Byzantium, so Ostikan, governor of Armenia, advanced down the Aras valley with the Nakhchivan garrison, and Smbat, with far fewer men, moved to meet him and strike first. Deeper down, the dispute was over the imperial frontier: this valley joined the lines of communication between Mesopotamia, the Caucasus and Anatolia, and whoever held it held the north-south route between Armenia and Georgia.
impact: 這一戰在短期內動搖了伍麥葉王朝對亞美尼亞的統治。斯姆巴特六世趁勝收復亞美尼亞大部分地區，把阿拉伯守軍逐出河谷，維持了一到兩年。哈里發很快作出反應，穆罕默德·伊本·馬爾萬與馬斯拉馬·伊本·阿卜杜勒·馬利克兩軍再入亞美尼亞，重新恢復宗主權，並於704年以極其手段收尾：亞美貴族首腦被召到納赫切萬的主教座堂內屠殺，教堂隨即被焚毀。亞美尼亞教會傳統把這批死者列為瓦斯普拉干殉道者，這一事件成為亞美尼亞民族敘事中最早的一頁血書，也加深了亞美貴族與阿拉伯統治者之間的嫌隙。長遠來看，阿拉斯河一線自此成為伍麥葉王朝與拜占庭帝國在高加索前線的實際分界，巴格拉圖尼氏的亞美尼亞則被壓縮成兩者之間的緩衝地，雙方在東方高加索的角力一直延續到中世紀。斯姆巴特六世本人則在約705年死於囚禁，這次起兵雖在戰術上得勝，卻未能改寫亞美尼亞被重新置於哈里發統治之下的結局。
impactEn: In the short term the battle shook Umayyad rule over Armenia. Smbat VI followed up the victory, recovered most of Armenia and drove the Arab garrisons out of the valley, holding it for a year or two. The caliph answered quickly: the armies of Muhammad ibn Marwan and Maslamah ibn Abd al-Malik marched back into Armenia, restored the suzerainty, and closed the episode in 704 with extreme measures — the Armenian noble leaders were summoned into the cathedral at Nakhchivan and killed there, and the church was burned. Armenian church tradition lists the dead among the Martyrs of Vaspurakan; the episode became the first written page of blood in the Armenian national narrative and deepened the mistrust between the Armenian aristocracy and their Arab rulers. In the longer term the Araxes became the practical dividing line between the Umayyad Caliphate and Byzantium on the Caucasian front, and Bagratuni Armenia was compressed into a buffer between the two, whose rivalry in the eastern Caucasus ran on into the Middle Ages. Smbat VI himself died in captivity around 705: the rising won on the field but did not alter the fact that Armenia was returned to Caliphal rule.
result: 戰術結果是亞美尼亞的完勝：兩千人的巴格拉圖尼部眾奇襲成功，五千人的伍麥葉守軍全軍崩潰，倖存者沿阿拉斯河逃竄，或為急流吞沒，或在冰面與嚴寒中凍斃，阿拉伯方在數年內重整旗鼓的計畫因此落空。斯姆巴特六世是這場戰爭的直接受益者，他收復亞美尼亞大部分地區，驅逐阿拉伯人，重新控制從凡達納克特到上游要塞的一整段河谷，並以拜占庭的冊立取得王位名分。戰略結果卻完全相反：不到兩年，伍麥葉王朝的大軍再度南下，重新把亞美尼亞變回哈里發國的一個行省，704年的納赫切萬屠殺與焚堂更把亞美貴族首腦一網打盡，斯姆巴特本人據記載於約705年死於囚禁。換句話說，瓦爾達納克特是亞美尼亞邊境抵抗的一次高光，卻沒有改變亞述式長矛早已退場、而帝國邊界仍由哈里發與拜占庭兩方力量決定的格局。
resultEn: The tactical result was a complete Armenian victory: the surprise attack by two thousand Bagratuni men succeeded, the five thousand-strong Umayyad garrison broke, and the survivors fled down the Araxes to be swallowed by the current or frozen to death on the ice, wrecking the Arab plans for a new offensive for years to come. Smbat VI was the direct beneficiary; he retook most of Armenia, drove out the Arabs, regained control of the whole stretch of valley from Vardanakert to the upper fortresses, and gained the title of kingship from the Byzantine investiture. The strategic result was the exact opposite: in under two years the armies of the caliphate came south again and turned Armenia back into a province of the caliph, while the killing of the Armenian nobles at Nakhchivan in 704 and the burning of the church swept away the heads of the Armenian aristocracy; Smbat himself is recorded as dying in captivity around 705. Put plainly, Vardanakert was a high point of Armenian frontier resistance that changed nothing about the pattern: the Assyrian-type spear had long since left the field, and the frontier itself remained where the balance of power between the caliph and Byzantium decided it.
